channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Dahntay Jones | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Dahntay Jones from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Kyrie Irving on Dahntay Jones
item.description:
“I think we all came to an agreement that Dahntay was the right person to put in,”

Kyrie Irving on Dahntay Jones, Mar 14, 2019. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Dahntay Jones
item.description:
Rick Noland:Lue on Dahntay:

“He brings some toughness and physicality, a little nasty, which we need at times”

Tyronn Lue on Dahntay Jones, Apr 12, 2017. Source: Twitter @RickNoland.

item.title: Paul George on Dahntay Jones
item.description:
Mike Wells:Paul George on if he expects Dahntay Jones to guard him:

“I don’t know, maybe. I just make sure the training staff has band aids on hand.”

Paul George on Dahntay Jones, Apr 26, 2013. Source: Twitter @MikeWellsNBA.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Dahntay Jones
item.description:
Earl K. Sneed:Joking Carlisle on Dahntay:

“I'm sure he'll be antagonizing the s--- out of me during the game.”

Rick Carlisle on Dahntay Jones, Mar 18, 2013. Source: Twitter @EarlKSneed.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Darren Collison, Chris Kaman, Dahntay Jones
item.description:
Mavericks coach Rick Carlisle said.

“Collison is well thought of as a player and a person, and Kaman has been one of the better low-post players in the league for the last eight years. We feel Dahntay Jones is a premier defender that brings toughness and he shot the 3 well the last two years.”

Rick Carlisle on Darren Collison, Chris Kaman, Dahntay Jones, Jul 13, 2012. Source: Fort Worth Star-Telegram.
